body: Moved from docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md on 6 Nov 2026 (the task files hold the definition only; how far a task is lives on the board). **Status 2026-10-22: the core is built and proved; catalogue/search, imports, the OpenAPI file and the Funnel route are open.** `server/encore_server/` (FastAPI, SQLite WAL, 2 migrations, ruff + mypy strict, 242 unit tests): song refs and matching, likes/saved albums/follows, playlists with fractional positions, plays, `library/changes` cursors, optimistic playback state with takeover, the live websocket, device tokens, signed stream addresses and `GET /encore/stream/{ref}` (cold song first bytes 2.7 s on the dev VM), the persisted **scheduler** (single flight, strict priorities, fair share between people, interactive and background pools, retries, resume after restart, Stop that cancels only what nobody else wants), the **keeper** (whole file through the stream proxy that reuses a play's address, WebM to Ogg Opus without re-encoding, tags with ISRC/MBID/cover, `<music>/Encore/Artist/Album/NN - Title.opus`, wait for the music server, attach, tell everybody who has the song) and the **scanner link** (every song of the library gets a ref and a file; one recording in many folders is one ref; a vanished file loses its row, never the ref). Keep rules D-3 are in: a like, a song added to a playlist, or a song listened to for 30 s on two different days by anybody. **Proved against a real Navidrome 0.64.2** (`tests/integration`, docker compose, also a CI job): the Host's collection becomes refs; a like keeps a song and Navidrome plays it with the right tags; a file moved by hand and a file re-tagged in place leave the like and the playlist entry unchanged; a deleted file is streamed again. **Proved on the dev VM** (port 4540, next to the old stack): like "Nude" -> kept as Opus in 12 s, in `/srv/music/Encore/Radiohead/In Rainbows/`, linked to Navidrome. Learned: Navidrome's Subsonic `path` is made from the tags (so a kept file is recognised by its size); a moved file keeps its song id; a file is re-read only if its old tags are dropped. Bugs found by the tests: a title with a slash never matched its own file name (a retry would have downloaded twice); the root-owned data folder made a first start loop forever (the entrypoint fixes it); login tokens were in the log (httpx quieted). Open: `catalogue` (Deezer/YTM search as an endpoint, P2-12), `imports` (P2-04), saved-album keeping, the cached-bytes sharing between a play and a keep, `openapi.yaml` + contract tests, the `/encore` route in the Funnel `serve.json` and at home, the install wizard's creation of the music-server administrator (today an environment variable).
